description: This file defines the class FormatWithCountryCode which implements the ValueFormatter interface. It provides functionality to format a value representing a country code into the corresponding country name using a country service.

classes.name: FormatWithCountryCode
classes.description: A class that formats a country code into a country name by fetching country data from a service.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the country name corresponding to the provided country code, or null if not found.
